Metadata.description: The UNICEF Club of School No. 130 is part of the UNICEF Club Mongolia network: a student club organising volunteer activities in three directions — advocacy, education and fundraising.

Common.emptyDescription: Join the club and do good together.

Footer.about: A student club of School No. 130 and a member of the UNICEF Club Mongolia network.
Footer.disclaimer: This is a school student club website, not an official UNICEF website.

Home.heroBody: We are the student club of School No. 130, part of the UNICEF Club Mongolia network. We organise volunteer activities in three directions: advocacy, education and fundraising.
Home.newsDescription: News and stories from our club.
Home.eventsDescription: Join us — helping hands are always needed.
Home.connectBody: We work together with partner organisations.
Home.connectBodyNoPartners: We work together with our school community.
Home.ctaTitle: You can be part of the change too
Home.ctaBody: Join the club and take part in helping children.

About.title: A club of students who want to help children
About.leadershipDescription: The team that organises the club's work.

directions.activity: Donation drives, preparing gifts and planting trees — activities that reach the wider community.
directions.education: Club meetings, working in teams and mentoring sessions — learning and growing together.
directions.charity: Charity sales and fundraising at tournaments.

why: Make a real difference for children

Contact.title: Get in touch

Support.title: How can you support us?

volunteer.body: Help at events, read to children, help with organising.

donateItems.title: Donate items

partner.body: Organisations and businesses can start joint campaigns and projects.
